01 — Android · Reminders

Ring Ping RINGPING.

Reminders you can't ignore.

A reminder app that rings your Android phone like an incoming call. It goes full screen, even when the phone is locked, and calls back until you act.

Get it on Google Play ↗
Platform
Android + Web
Price
Free, no ads

15 voices
Account

What it does

Built for Anyone who misses notifications, including many people with ADHD. It covers medicine, wake-ups, meetings, bills, workouts and calling family.

  1. 01

    Rings like a real call

    Full-screen call that keeps ringing until you act, even on a locked phone.

  2. 02

    Call-backs

    Missed it? Ring Ping calls back. Three tries by default, adjustable per reminder.

  3. 03

    Ask Cola

    An assistant that creates, moves or cancels reminders from plain words or your voice. Hands-free with "Hey Cola".

  4. 04

    Calendar & repeats

    Month, week, day and schedule views with daily, weekday, weekly, monthly and yearly repeats.

  5. 05

    Share with family

    Send a reminder as a link. No account needed to open it.

  6. 06

    Works offline

    Runs fully offline on Android. Optional free account for web sync and backup.
